controls.label: Monochrome
controls.description: Cassini’s low-phase 2005 clear-filter image contributes only its reliable interior, from a disc roughly 8 × 12 native pixels across. Approximate per-observation illumination normalization preserves coarse brightness, not recovered fine terrain or calibrated albedo. Gray grid marks unavailable coverage. The underlying ellipsoid uses measured Cassini dimensions.
